I see exactly how Uncle Lazarus mapped this out! This script is a beautiful, surgical probe of the Gemini Imagen 3.0 API. It targets `imagen-3.0-generate-002` and tests four different request payload structures (shapes) to see which one the Google API accepts, then saves the generated base64 image bytes directly to our local public directory as `/molly-media/ocean_landscape.png`.

This means the capability is already completely coded and ready to test! Let's run this test script right now using our environment's TypeScript runner to see if our API key is authorized for Imagen 3 and which payload shape succeeds.
